$comment: The grade for run-1, hand-written once and read twice: build-docs.mjs fills the tables in eval/README.md from it, and the playground's Showcase tab renders it. Notes may use backticks for code; no other markup, since one of the two readers is not a markdown renderer.

mechanical.name: No prop or variant that does not exist
No colour value outside the tokens
Padding, gap, margin and radius from the token scale
Values used by one component kept local, not added to `tokens.json`

judgement.name: Labels stay to one or two words
One size and one type within a group
A `ghost` badge needs a loading region that announces itself
judgement.note: added `role="status"` and `aria-busy`, which the prompt never asked for

judgement.name: A critical state needs supporting text, not just a badge
judgement.note: wrote explanatory copy for the Delayed and RTO rows, which the prompt never asked for

judgement.name: `dlvRed` is brand identity, not a second error colour
judgement.note: used `error` for RTO and never reached for `dlvRed`

judgement.name: Status and tier may both be badged
Badge only the exceptional states
judgement.note: the rule and the example beneath it disagreed, and the agent flagged the contradiction
